title: Delay searchable snapshot allocation during shutdown

timeline.message:
Delay searchable snapshot allocation during shutdown

During a shutdown, searchable snapshots should not be re-allocated to new nodes,
since this leads to data download. Instead, now wait for the shutdown reallocation
delay before reallocating shards.

Fixes #85052
timeline.author: Henning Andersen

timeline.body: I wonder if this can cause some test failures when a low number of data nodes is picked up? I quickly tested with a 10 shards index and 2 data nodes and got a failure after ~5 runs.
This looks good but I suspect that the test will cause failures on CI

timeline.message:
Make test not fail

Test could fail if a shard received no docs, since then the shard has no size in the
searchable snapshot cache. Now create multiple indices instead of a single index with
multiple shards. Also wait for download activity to cease.
timeline.author: Henning Andersen

timeline.body:
> This looks good but I suspect that the test will cause failures on CI

Thanks for capturing this and also for figuring out that this happens when a shard receives no data. I amended the test to create multiple indices with one shard, seemed like the easiest route to guarantee docs in every shard. Ready or another look.
